On a PostgreSQL 17 project ALL also held MAINTAIN; it must not appear below either. The PGlite dry run (`verify-live-bundle.mjs`) starts from the Supabase default privileges and checks this table after the parts.

Waves E to H reached `main` with PRs #1-#4 (their bundles are applied by the apply session; wave H merged at `375b3ab`), and this branch (PR #6) now targets `main`: apply `waveH/` and check it against its `EXPECTED.md`, and only then this bundle. Wave I needs earlier objects live: F01 `kafaa_skill_evidence` / `kafaa_person_skills` / `kafaa_skills_apply`, F11 `kafaa_team_skill_targets` and `kafaa_team_coverage` (w2e1), FS05 `kafaa_role_profile_versions`, FS06/FS11 `kafaa_rt_*` and `kafaa_fx_exposure`, FS08 `kafaa_skill_alignments`, FS18 `kafaa_external_resources` / `kafaa_xr_check`, FS20 academies, FS27 `kafaa_opp_line_manager`, FS30 credits, FS32 `kafaa_record_shares` and the `kafaa_lr_*` functions (fs43), FS36 `kafaa_ai_systems`, F28 `kafaa_sim_scenarios`, F38 `kafaa_ojt_logs`. The shared functions wave I redefines are `kafaa_team_coverage` (fs95, from its only body, w2e1) and the three FS32 helpers `kafaa_lr_refs_ok`, `kafaa_lr_items`, `kafaa_lr_bundle` (fs9qa, from their only bodies, fs43). `kafaa_skill_states_v2` and `kafaa_skills_apply` are not redefined (wave-I evidence uses recorded kinds). The PGlite dry run started from the migrations and seed of `main` at `375b3ab` (the wave-H merge; same tree as `fsH-integration-qa`) (the post-wave-H state, which equals live after the wave-H bundle for every object wave I reads), applied every part twice and found every md5 and digest below equal. **Audit fixes (PR #5, `docs/kafaa/ref/live_apply/audit_fixes/`):** its migrations are dated after wave I and touch none of the objects this bundle creates or redefines, so the order of the two bundles does not matter: the dry run also passes with the five audit-fixes migrations applied to the base first (134/134, 21/21, 2/2).
notes: Notes on the parts. **Pre-wave state:** the state AFTER the wave-H bundle (see section 0). **New objects:** the five feature migrations create 11 new `kafaa_*` tables (FS78/FS79 `learning_balances`, `study_time_requests`, `external_certs`; FS80 `automations`, `automation_adoptions`; FS81 `transition_plans`; FS82/FS83 `grant_rounds`, `grant_applications`, `consortium_cohorts`, `consortium_members`, `consortium_visits`) with RLS in the per-statement form, their RPCs and internal helpers, plus two additive columns on `kafaa_team_skill_targets` (`horizon` default 'current', `profile_version_ids` default '{}'; the 24 existing rows take the defaults through `alter table ... add column if not exists`, not through an UPDATE statement). **Shared redefinitions:** `kafaa_fs95_team_targets_inventory` replaces `kafaa_team_coverage` (from the w2e1 body; F11 reads horizon 'current' only); the QA part `kafaa_fs9qa_integration_p1` replaces the FS32 helpers `kafaa_lr_refs_ok` (accepts the new `xcert:` share reference), `kafaa_lr_items` (verified, unexpired external certificates as record items with their trust tier) and `kafaa_lr_bundle` (the record statement of such a certificate), same signatures, still executable by no API role. **Statements that update existing rows:** no top-level UPDATE; the replay part re-derives the person-skill states of the people whose recorded wave-I evidence the seed parts insert (section 1a). **Seed rows** load with `kafaa.seeding` on: the three synthetic consortium partners first, rounds before applications, cohorts before members before visits, gallery entries before adoptions, certificates before their evidence; new rows of existing tables: 9 FS79 and 9 FS80 `skill_evidence` rows, 3 new `person_skills` rows, FS78/FS79/FS81/FS82/FS83 notifications, the 35 FS84 team targets and the 3 organisations. No new policy resource: no `kafaa_policy_matrix` rows to insert. **Table grants:** section 4a lists the grants on the new tables only. **Expected drift after live use:** journeys add requests, certificates, adoptions, plans, applications, visits, targets and audit rows; live `kafaa_person_skills` holds extra journey rows for some personas (compare the replayed people's states by id).
